title: Gradient sync explorer — the communication wall

checkpoints.hint: Keep the model and bandwidth fixed and slide the device count up. Per-device compute keeps shrinking (each device does less of the batch) but the all-reduce barely changes — so the red comm bar overtakes the green compute bar and the run goes communication-bound: adding devices stops buying speed. Now flip Overlap on and watch the comm hide behind compute. Interconnect bandwidth and overlap are the levers, not device count.
